chk.text: Toshiro Umezawa is sent with Uramon's hitmen to attack Hidetsugu, survives, and convinces the ogre to form the Hyozan Reckoners with him.
He steals the Taken One from Eiganjo and frees its spirit, who takes the name Kyodai, and he rescues Michiko after Kobo is killed by Choryu.
Toshi tricks Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into joining the Hyozan Reckoners, and bound by the oath they help him steal the Shadow Gate from Uramon.

When Hidetsugu turns on them, Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and Toshi stabs through the other, but in the end Toshi loses Night's Reach's blessings and is transported to Dominaria, blinded, to become the first of Clan Umezawa.

sok.text: Toshiro Umezawa receives a kanji message from Michiko that Eiganjo has fallen and the soratami are conquering, and he meets Hidetsugu, who wants his full commitment to the Hyozan Reckoners, but Toshi refuses and they become enemies.
He helps Kiku control her shadow powers and recruits Marrow-Gnawer, and at Minamo Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu's eyes, bringing the oath's wrath on himself, so Toshi mercy kills him.
Toshi freezes Uyo solid and teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm, and Michiko frees the spirit, who is named Kyodai.
Chiyo mortally wounds Toshi, but Night's Reach saves him and teleports him to Dominaria, blinding him on Madara.

neo.text: Reki describes Toshiro Umezawa as either the hero of the Kami War or a selfish thief.
He steals That Which Was Taken and carries it to safety, and gives it to Michiko Konda, ending the Kami War.
Toshiro disobeys the Myojin of Night's Reach, who takes his eyesight and banishes him to Dominaria, where he founds Umezawa Manor.
